execution.ref: carbon/agent_campaign/graphite/phase4.py check_view; tests/cpu/test_graphite_phase4.py (slice AT-E, integration round 1)
execution.description: Ran the integrated phase-4 dry run on battery Level 0 and checked that every Track A check is named in the coverage report and in B2.

expected: Each of the eight Track A checks would appear in the coverage report, either through a run family or through a declared NOT_RUN seam.
observed: Every seam row carried check None, because the engine report kept only a seam's name and reason. fresh_attack_confirmation is covered only by seams on battery Level 0, so no row named it and the per-check view showed seven of the eight checks. The tests passed because none of them asserted which checks the report named.
keep: A coverage report accounts for every Track A check, taking each family's check from the adapter's declarations rather than from report rows.
A check nothing declares is listed as undeclared and never counted as covered.
change: Seam rows in the engine report and B2 carry their SeamFamily.check (AT-C report repair).
Engine-path tests assert that all eight checks appear and that no row has lost its check.
